definitions.explanation: Describes doing something with force, energy, or without restraint.
Mimics the sound of repeated banging or hitting.

examples.japanese: {意見|いけん}をばんばん{言|い}ってください。
ばんばん{仕事|しごと}を{片付|かたづ}ける。
examples.english: To knock out work at a brisk pace.

examples.japanese: {太鼓|たいこ}をばんばん{叩|たた}いた。
{新規|しんき}{顧客|こきゃく}がばんばん{増|ふ}えている。

notes:
ばんばん is an onomatopoeic adverb that mimics banging sounds. Figuratively, it means doing something vigorously, without hesitation or restraint.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・ばんばん{使|つか}う (use freely)
・ばんばん{売|う}れる (sell like hotcakes)
・ばんばん{言|い}う (speak without hesitation)
・ばんばん{叩|たた}く (bang repeatedly)

NUANCE: More emphatic than どんどん. Suggests force or enthusiasm.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・どんどん: One after another (neutral)
・ばんばん: Vigorously, forcefully
・じゃんじゃん: Freely, without restraint
